description:
Store owners can request that data is deleted on behalf of a customer. When this happens, Shopify sends a payload on the customers/redact topic to the apps installed on that store.

Customer redaction occurs at the end of the grace period after the redaction was requested (today + 10 days). If the customer is the recipient of a gift card that is scheduled to be sent after that date, redaction is deferred until the gift card has been sent.
name: customers/redact
